title: Annette NDE 6375
content: Basically I remember being in a queue, some people I knew or recognized and others I didn't. This part is a bit vague. The next stage I remember very clearly. I was in a tunnel, which seemed to be moving round/rotating. I was not rotating, just walking forward. As I walked through the tunnel, the walls were changing color all the time. The only way I can describe it was that it reminded me of a kaleidoscope toy a friend of mine had. The colors moved and were ever changing. The colors in the tunnel were not so strong. I remember blues and lemons. As I looked straight ahead, I could see a pinhead of white. I thought it was the end of the tunnel. It seemed like forever to get to the end and then suddenly all I could see was white light and nothing else. It was bright but didn't hurt my eyes. I could look into it. Then I heard someone call my name. When I looked, I saw a man standing dressed in unusual, non-western clothes, like a plain robe. He had a small child at his side. He reached out his hand, called my name, and gestured for me to come over but I would not go. Next, I remember a faint stinging sensation on my face and heard a woman calling my name. I was starting to regain consciousness. The dental staff was really slapping my face hard to wake me up. I told my mum what I experienced and I told her the man was Jesus. She told me not to be so stupid. I forgot about this incident until about 15 years ago. I needed my birth certificate and asked my mum if I could have it. She told it was in a drawer upstairs and to go get it. There were other certificates there. I came across a birth certificate but the date of birth was wrong. I thought she couldn't have gotten my birth date wrong. Then I looked at the year of birth, it was 10 years before me. So, I went downstairs to ask my mum. She told me it was her first baby that only lived for 2 hours after birth. Then my mind went back to the day I was at the dentist: the man, I thought, was Jesus and I wondered if the child beside him was maybe my dead sister. This is why I believe this was a near death experience.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Walking forward through a tunnel that seemed to be moving round/rotating (the experiencer was not rotating).

arrival.religious_figure_detail: The experiencer told her mother the man was Jesus.
arrival.other_being_detail: A small child stood at the man's side; later the experiencer wondered the child might have been her dead sister.

environment.environment_other_detail: Tunnel walls changing color like a kaleidoscope; blues and lemons; then only white light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Loss of consciousness during a dental procedure (dental staff slapping her face to wake her).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial 'queue' with some recognized and unrecognized people; later a man (identified as Jesus) with a small child; heard name called; returned as dental staff woke her.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Queue of people → rotating tunnel with changing colors → white light → man in robe with child calling her name and gesturing → refusal to go → return to consciousness as staff called/slapped her.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A 'queue' of people at the beginning; tunnel described as rotating with kaleidoscope-like changing colors (blues and lemons).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was in a tunnel, which seemed to be moving round/rotating.”; “The only way I can describe it was that it reminded me of a kaleidoscope toy…”; “suddenly all I could see was white light and nothing else. It was bright but didn't hurt my eyes.”
